text: The subject is Omer Yousaf, who holds account PK**MUCB****9220 opened on 19 July 2023. The subject declared an occupation of Student with a monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. Between 3 March 2026 and 12 March 2026, the account recorded 29 credits totalling PKR 1,392,000 and 6 debits totalling PKR 1,204,000. The credits consisted of 29 interbank (IBFT) transfers received from 24 distinct senders. An alert was raised by Tazama on 12 March 2026, where Tazama typology MULE-01 scored 360 against an alert threshold of 300. The receipt of funds from 24 distinct senders is indicative of the money mule activity typology. Debits equal to 86% of credits, with a median of 6.4 hours between the latest credit and each debit, are consistent with rapid pass-through activity. Credits in the activity window were 55.7 times the declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month for a Student, which is inconsistent with the customer profile. Two sender banks raised fraud recall requests against inbound transfers to this account, citing scam complaints, as noted by Fraud Desk on 11 March 2026. The activity, involving 24 distinct senders and credits 55.7 times the declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month for a Student, is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 831,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 4 transactions. PKR 373,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 2 transactions. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 30 March 2026. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review by L2 analyst on 13 March 2026.
